claim_boundary.scope: registered PSPLIB multi-mode families and instances only

greatest_rank_positional_weight.policy_definition: Parallel SGS using greatest rank positional weight (GRPW): own minimum duration plus minimum durations of all transitive successors.

minimum_slack.policy_definition: Parallel SGS using minimum slack (MINSLK), equivalently greatest remaining minimum-duration critical path at a common decision epoch.

most_total_successors.policy_definition: Parallel SGS using most total successors (MTS), then critical-path and shorter-duration tie breaks.

shortest_processing_time.policy_definition: Non-delay parallel schedule-generation scheme (SGS) using shortest processing time (SPT), then lower normalized resource demand.

fixed_budget.claim_boundary: A time-bounded makespan reference. FEASIBLE is not an optimality proof; mean flow is descriptive because CP-SAT optimizes makespan only.

ours_runtime_matched_solver_budget.claim_boundary: A time-bounded makespan reference. FEASIBLE is not an optimality proof; mean flow is descriptive because CP-SAT optimizes makespan only.
